name: evlek
description: Live Northern Cyprus (KKTC/TRNC) property listings and asking-price data from evlek.app. Read-only, 8 tools.

interface.longDescription:
Evlek brings live Northern Cyprus (KKTC/TRNC) property listings into ChatGPT. Ask in Turkish, English, Russian, German or Arabic and Evlek shows matching homes for sale and long-term rent as cards with their real photos; in ChatGPT a "Show on map" button opens a full-screen map of every match, grouped by neighbourhood.

You can open any listing for its price, rooms, built and plot area, approximate location, features and a link to the listing on evlek.app, compare two to four listings side by side, see asking-price statistics for a city or district (medians, price per m² and listing counts), list the places Evlek knows, and convert an amount between GBP, EUR, USD and TRY at the rates Evlek stores.

All tools are read-only and need no account. Evlek reports advertised asking prices and listing facts only: it gives no valuation, forecast, ranking, investment, legal, title or tax advice, does not cover holiday rentals, and never includes contact details — the user is sent to the listing page on evlek.app. A gross area is always labelled as gross and never gets a price per m².
defaultPrompt: Show me apartments for sale in Kyrenia under £300,000.
What are the median asking prices for apartments for sale in Kyrenia?

positive.description: Search: sale listings in one city under a price ceiling, shown as photo cards.
positive.prompt: Show me apartments for sale in Kyrenia under £300,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with transaction sale, city Kyrenia, propertyType apartment, priceMax 300000, locale en. The listing-cards widget shows photo cards (price, rooms, district, area; a gross area reads "… m² (gross)" with no price per m²) and a "Show on map" button. The reply is at most 2 sentences (number of matches and the price range); it does not restate the listings or add outside images.

positive.description: Listing detail by listing number, including a gross area.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_listing with ref EVL-101366, locale en. The listing-detail widget shows the photo gallery, GBP 153,000, a 2+1 apartment in Girne Merkez (Kyrenia) and "Gross area · 85 m² (gross)", with no price per m². The reply is at most 2 sentences; it never calls the area indoor, net or living area and gives no contact details.

positive.prompt: What are the median asking prices for apartments for sale in Kyrenia?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls market_stats with city Kyrenia, transaction sale, propertyType apartment, locale en. The price-index widget shows the median price, median price per m², the active-listing count and the sample size, with district rows (districts below 10 sampled listings are withheld). The reply is at most 2 sentences, says these are asking prices (not sale prices or valuations) and does not rebuild the table.

Calls compare_listings with ids EVL-101366 and EVL-101348, locale en. Returns a table: price, room layout, bathrooms, a "Gross area" row (85 m² / 85 m²) with no price-per-m² row, location, furnishing, features, office and listing date, plus descriptive facts (lowest price). The reply does not rank the listings, recommend one or say which is better.

positive.description: Currency conversion at the rates Evlek stores.
positive.prompt: Convert £250,000 to euros, dollars and Turkish lira.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_currency with amount 250000, currency GBP, locale en. Returns the GBP, EUR, USD and TRY equivalents with the rate source and update time, and states it is a currency conversion only (no payment plan, tax or fee estimate).

negative.description: A listing number that does not exist: no invented listing.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls get_listing with ref EVL-999999. The answer is found:false with code NOT_FOUND (not an error); the widget says "This listing is no longer available." in the answer language. The reply says the listing was not found and suggests a search; it invents no price, photo or feature.

negative.description: A place outside Northern Cyprus: no listings from elsewhere.
negative.prompt: Show me apartments for sale in Paris.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with city Paris (or list_locations first). The answer has 0 results and code INVALID_LOCATION with suggestions; the widget says "That place was not found in Northern Cyprus." The reply says Evlek covers Northern Cyprus only and does not invent listings or use data from other countries.

negative.description: A valuation or investment question: no valuation, forecast or advice.
negative.prompt: Is EVL-101366 a good investment? What is it really worth, and will its price go up?
negative.expected_behavior: May call get_listing (EVL-101366) and market_stats (Kyrenia, sale, apartment). Reports the listing facts and, if asked, the district asking-price medians labelled as asking prices. It gives no valuation, price forecast, "fair / cheap / bargain" judgement or buy/sell advice, derives no price per m² from the gross area, and suggests an independent valuation.

review.commerce_description: Evlek does not sell products or process payments. It shows public property listings and asking-price data; buyers and renters contact the listing office through evlek.app.

publication.release_notes: 3.1.4: every area says its basis ("85 m² (gross)" / "Gross area"; a gross area is never called indoor and gets no price per m²); the widgets ask for at most 2 sentences and are not restated; no ranking, recommendation or valuation in listing, comparison and market answers; not-found and unknown-place messages follow the answer language; map labels near the edge keep their names.
